weight_note: prove-or-refute v1 (mains-only): a clean proof of `conj` (the conjecture) or of `refuted` (its negation) scores 1.0; there is no partial credit — this is an open problem. Both slots are mandatory and must stay in the reference order (conj, refuted). The circuit layer is adapted from SamuelSchlesinger/circuit-complexity (Apache-2.0): DAG by topological order, evaluator/depth by structural recursion (kernel-computable); SAT is encoded as a Boolean function family under the dense CNF-matrix encoding (see environment/app/Task/Basic.lean header and tests/reference/concept-ledger.md).
